messages:
Maya R: heads-up — us-west1 p4d pool at ~93% alloc, queue depth spiking for 1-2s requests. 95th latency creeping up ~120ms. seeing more worker churn.
opsbot: ALERT: saturation_detected us-west1-gpu-pool (p4d) metric:util=93% queue=180 avg_latency=85ms
Daniel K: can we start regional spill to us-east1 for non-P0 traffic? avoid expensive preemptible churn.
Priya S: us-east1 has capacity but a bunch of customers are region-pinned (PCI/PHI). we need a filter: only spill non-pinned tenants and non-critical plans.
Leo (oncall): +1 on filter. also watch egress cost — some tenants have egress caps. which pool do we prefer for cost vs latency tradeoff?
Maya R: Proposal: immediate 10% canary spill of standard tier -> us-east1; if 5m steady, ramp to 40%. For fallback model, prefer `rwd-2-small-q4` (quantized) for spilled traffic to save tokens/latency.
Daniel K: agree. we should also enable temporary admission control for best-effort customers: throttle to 60r/s per tenant until spill stabilizes.
Priya S: note: some enterprise tenants flagged as "must-stay-local" in tenancy metadata. I'll publish an allowlist to the routing policy before we flip it.
Maya R: here's the routing snippet I'll push to the control plane (canary 10%):
```
routing_policy:
  name: regional_spill_splay
  canary_percent: 10
  rules:
    - match: tier=="standard" and NOT metadata.region_pinned
      prefer_regions: ["us-west1","us-east1"]
      fallback_model: "rwd-2-small-q4"
      admission_limit: 0.6   # admit 60% under pressure
```
Leo (oncall): run `deployctl route apply --file policy.yaml --canary 10`? I can watch. will enable alert thresholds for error-rate + latency.
Daniel K: cost note — quantized fallback reduces GPU memory and token time. expect ~25% cost decrease for spilled traffic. but cross-region egress could offset if responses large.
Priya S: I'll send a short outbound to CS + Sales with pinned-list reminder: "We're routing non-pinned standard traffic to us-east1 temporarily due to us-west1 saturation". tagging affected customers.
Maya R: action items: (1) I will push canary at 1765432300, (2) Priya publish allowlist and notify CS, (3) Daniel monitor cost delta and rollback if egress spike > +10%.
Leo (oncall): monitoring hooks: added dashboards for spill_ratio, per-region 95th, and egress_delta. setting pager if error-rate > 1% for premium tier.
Maya R: pushing canary now. will update thread in 5m with metrics.
opsbot: ROUTE_CHANGE: applied policy regional_spill_splay canary=10 by Maya R at 1765432300
Maya R: canary traffic steady at 10% for 3m, 95th in us-west1 unchanged, us-east1 latency +30ms but within SLO. no errors observed. ramping to 40% now.
Daniel K: noted. watching cost and egress; will call rollback if needed.
Priya S: CS informed. flagged two tenants as pinned; excluded from spill.
Leo (oncall): keeping eyes. leaving retention note: revisit permanent policy for regional_cost_aware_splay next week.
